# Zhurakov

Zhurakov (zhurakov.com) is an open-source web playground by Nikita Zhurakov. The homepage headline is "Hello, World!". It is built with plain HTML, CSS, and a little JavaScript.

## Important pages

- Home: https://zhurakov.com/ — An open-source web playground with small experiments, games, and useful pages.
- Pond: https://zhurakov.com/posts/pond.html — Nikita Zhurakov's pixel koi pond. Move the pointer to attract the fish and click to feed them.
- Link Library: https://zhurakov.com/posts/links.html — A growing personal library of websites and web projects worth sharing.
- Games: https://zhurakov.com/posts/games.html — A small games page with a retro arcade mood.
- Music: https://zhurakov.com/posts/music.html — A quiet lofi-inspired music room.
- Antistress: https://zhurakov.com/antistress/ — An interactive WebGL fluid simulation. Touch, drag, and slow down.
- Privacy: https://zhurakov.com/privacy.html — How this site uses optional analytics.

## Link Library

The Link Library is a collection of websites, services, and projects worth sharing. Inclusion does not imply that Nikita uses, endorses, or is affiliated with a listed project.
